free_text: A biopsy is recommended because the patient has a known prior positive biopsy and is currently on an active surveillance protocol. This decision is supported by the documented rising PSA trend from 3.5 ng/mL to 5.3 ng/mL and the presence of a PI-RADS 4 lesion on MRI. The room converged on this course of action because the documented active surveillance protocol indicated a need for further histological clarification.
